_comment: Orchestration section of the catalog site. Summarises claude/skills/project-manager/SKILL.md (sections 0-2) and claude/rules/agent-routing.md; update this file when either changes. build_site.py fails if an agent named here is not in claude/agents/.
intro: The project-manager skill routes tasks without writing code. It checks for existing work, assigns a tier by size and risk, and delegates to specialist agents in order. Independent steps run in parallel within a single message.

preflight.title: Already-done check
preflight.note: Searches git history and the codebase. If the feature already exists on the target branch, the PM reports it and halts before any agent runs. Skipped for bug fixes and refactors.

preflight.title: Classify the tier
preflight.note: Classifies the task as small, medium, or large based on the triggers below. If uncertain between 1 and 2, unverified backend endpoints or 5+ interaction states elevate the task to Tier 2.

tiers.name: Fast path
tiers.triggers: UI/UX tweaks, text changes, simple CSS fixes, label renames

stages.note: Finds the files and patterns to reuse. Returns them inline; no task file is created.
Makes the change, then self-checks: exactly what was asked, no stray files, no new data access.
Runs only when the change touches auth, permissions, data access, migrations, secrets, or privileged server code.

tiers.name: Standard path
tiers.triggers: CRUD operations, form logic, category management, well-understood APIs

stages.note: Reusable code and conventions.
Ambiguities, edge cases, testable acceptance criteria. Pauses for the user on a blocking question.
Consolidates context and requirements into one self-contained task file.
Implements exactly what the task file says.
Checks every acceptance criterion; updates the changelog on PASS.
Security, performance and architecture audit: APPROVED or BLOCKED.
Verifies UI changes in the running application through the DOM. Skipped for non-UI tasks or offline environments. On pass, the PM offers an optional manual verification checklist.
Records new root causes and anti-patterns. On a clean run, the PM logs "no new entries" instead of invoking the agent.

tiers.name: Extended path
tiers.triggers: Unknown or unverified backend APIs, complex interaction states, data aggregations, auth, exports

stages.note: Reusable code and conventions.
Ambiguities, edge cases, testable acceptance criteria. Pauses for the user on a blocking question.

stages.title: Discover APIs
stages.note: The PM inspects the project API inventory so endpoints are verified before implementation.
Maps each UI action to an endpoint marked EXISTS or MISSING, with a fallback plan. If 50% or more are MISSING, the chain pauses for user confirmation.
Consolidates specs, decisions and the technical schema into one task file.
Frontend work plus any approved backend gap work.
Checks every acceptance criterion; updates the changelog on PASS.
Security, performance and architecture audit: APPROVED or BLOCKED.
Verifies UI changes in the running application through the DOM. Skipped for non-UI tasks or offline environments. On pass, the PM offers an optional manual verification checklist.
Also records shipped MISSING-endpoint fallbacks. Skipped on a clean run.

fix_loop.note: If reviewers or live-verifier flag blockers, reports return to fullstack-developer together before re-verification. If a blocker persists through 2 fix attempts, the chain pauses for human guidance. For PASS WITH AMENDMENT (conflicting criteria while code is sound), the PM adjusts the task file directly.
